load_box2d_trajectory_from_csv: load hand 2D bounding box data from a CSV file and return a HandBox2dProvider
parse_box2ds_from_csv_reader: parse a CSV reader into a HandBox2dTrajectoryCollection with bounding boxes per stream and timestamp
get_data_statistics: get statistics including frame counts and stream IDs from a HandBox2dProvider
get_bbox_at_timestamp: query hand 2D bounding boxes at a specific timestamp for a given camera stream
get_timestamp_ns_list: get the sorted list of nanosecond timestamps available for a specific camera stream
